name: harnesshub-workspace
description: Open-source control plane for coding agents: wire any agent to any model, run them headless through one API, and keep the evidence.

scripts.build: node tools/clean-build.mjs && tsc -b && node tools/build-info.mjs && node tools/build-keychain.mjs && node tools/build-windows-job.mjs && node packages/store/native/build-windows-acl.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.legacy.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.mjs "packages/*/package.json" "packages/*/tsconfig.json" "packages/*/src/**/*.ts" "packages/*/test/**/*.ts" "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "tools/check-boundaries*.mjs" "tools/check-runtime*.mjs" ".github/workflows/*.yml"
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.legacy.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.mjs "packages/*/package.json" "packages/*/tsconfig.json" "packages/*/src/**/*.ts" "packages/*/test/**/*.ts" "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "tools/check-boundaries*.mjs" "tools/check-runtime*.mjs" ".github/workflows/*.yml"
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm test:tooling && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:smoke
scripts.check: pnpm check:runtime && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:spdx && pnpm check:labels && pnpm test && pnpm check:api && pnpm check:console
